images.observations: Front and right facade retain grey-taupe shading elements, opaque green-grey window backs and historical grey stairs; added white reveals sit within the existing openings. Both portico voids remain visibly open. Roof field, inner parapet and service block remain neutral. Full model fits the frame.

Rear end, recessed return and oblique facade show continuous pale wall faces and existing opaque mixed window backs. Recess shapes and original rear-wing/oblique outline are intact, with no arbitrary diagonal paint patches or invented window frames. Roof and base remain neutral.

Unequal left four-row and right three-row facade window groups, middle horizontal slits, lower right vertical slits and four upper right openings are intact. Original grey-taupe shades and grey stair scheme remain. Front returns are light within their existing cut boundaries; no letters or new openings.

Front/right source-like view shows pale host walls and neutral grey-taupe shades with consistent complete window reveals. Both actual portico voids remain open. No stair artwork, geometry change or external texture. All edges fit the image.

Oblique flank and recessed return show existing seven-row shallow openings with grey-green opaque backs and continuous pale walls; original approximate geometry is unchanged. No false frames, strips or diagonal material boundaries. Neutral roof, parapet inner surfaces and base remain distinct.

Original paired right-side windows, continuous central recess, grey-taupe shelves and front-side portico remain intact. New reveal surfaces remain inside original complete cuts, without closing open portico space.

Original trapezoid footprint, narrow rear wing, roof service block, parapet and stair projection preserved. Roof field, coping top and artificial base stay neutral; no invented roof equipment, images, text or geometry. All geometry fits the frame.

Restored original assignment at identical front camera confirms unchanged geometry, shade/entrance/stair palette and neutral roof/base. Final front view differs in previously neutral reveals and complete outer parapet faces, without repainting original colored surfaces.

Restored original rear camera confirms the missing-color condition: entire original rear, return, oblique wall and window recesses were neutral. Final view preserves the exact openings and outline while applying qualified wall/window continuity; roof and base remain unchanged.
